name: vscode-hacker-markdown
description: A Markdown preview you can dock in the Panel or Primary Sidebar, or open in the Editor.

hackerMarkdown.scrollPreviewWithEditor.description: When the cursor moves in the Markdown editor, scroll the preview to the matching line.

hackerMarkdown.scrollEditorWithPreview.description: When the preview is scrolled, scroll the Markdown editor to the matching line.

hackerMarkdown.styles.description: Custom CSS files applied to the preview. Accepts file:// URLs, absolute paths, and https URLs; relative paths are resolved against the Markdown file's folder.

hackerMarkdown.renderOnSave.description: Re-render the preview only when the Markdown document is saved. When disabled, the preview re-renders live (debounced) as you type.

hackerMarkdown.plantuml.server.description: PlantUML server used to render `puml`/`plantuml`/`uml` fences in the preview as SVG images (e.g. http://localhost:8080). When empty, those fences stay as ordinary code blocks.

hackerMarkdown.plantuml.includepaths.description: Additional folders to resolve `!include` / `!includesub` directives against, beyond the Markdown file's own folder.

commands.title: Hacker Markdown: Open Preview in Editor

scripts.compile: npm run build:syntax && npm run build:webview && npm run build:webview-assets && tsc -p ./ && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json
